body:
hexagon: extend scalar DMA broadcasting support for binary ops ( #30245 )

- tests: cover weighted scalar broadcasts

- ggml : support extended scalar DMA binary ops

hex-binary: remove all non-dma paths

hex-binary: add support for non-contig strides and cleanup dma preable a bit

hex-binary: cleanup the gating and simplify dma retry

hex-geglu-erf: add a gate for F32 only, we dont support F16 for this op

tests: cover weighted repeat broadcast

hex-binary: update REPEAT and COMPLEX kernels to use dma as well (missed them last time)

hex-add-id: add dma support for src2 (idx)

Co-authored-by: Max Krasnyansky maxk@qti.qualcomm.com

summaryZh: llama.cpp 发布 b11580 构建版本，主要扩展了 Hexagon 架构下二元算子的标量 DMA 广播支持，并在 ggml 中移除所有非 DMA 路径。同时，该版本更新了跨平台构建产物，覆盖高通 Snapdragon、CUDA 等运行环境。

aiReview.reasonZh: llama.cpp 发布日常构建，重点对高通 Hexagon NPU 的 DMA 广播和二元算子支持进行了优化。
